literal_meaning: তেল দেওয়া বা তেল মর্দন করা (giving or rubbing oil)
figurative_meaning_en: Flattery in a servile or lowly manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বসকে তৈলদান করে সুবিধা পেতে চায়।
রাজনীতিতে অনেকে তৈলদানের মাধ্যমে উন্নতি করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He bootlicks his boss to gain favors.
In politics, many advance through servile flattery.
history: This idiom likely originates from traditional Bengali rural practices where servants would offer oil massages to please landlords or superiors, symbolizing obsequious behavior.
note: The idiom reflects hierarchical social structures in historical Bengal.
